where.if: AND ( CAST(r.CODE AS CHAR) LIKE #{keywordPattern} ESCAPE '!' OR CAST(r.TARGET_CODE AS CHAR) LIKE #{keywordPattern} ESCAPE '!' OR r.CONTENT LIKE #{keywordPattern} ESCAPE '!' )

mapper.select:
SELECT r.CODE, r.MEM_CODE, r.TARGET_TYPE, r.TARGET_CODE, r.REASON_TYPE, r.CONTENT, r.STATUS, r.CREATED_AT
FROM REPORT r
ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC, r.CODE DESC
LIMIT #{perPage} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.CODE, r.MEM_CODE, r.TARGET_TYPE, r.TARGET_CODE, r.REASON_TYPE, r.CONTENT, r.STATUS, r.CREATED_AT,
reporter.ID AS REPORTER_ID,
COALESCE(f.MEM_CODE, c.MEM_CODE, p.MEM_CODE) AS TARGET_MEMBER_CODE,
targetMember.ID AS TARGET_MEMBER_ID,
processLog.CODE AS PROCESS_LOG_CODE, processLog.ADM_CODE,
adminAccount.EMP_ID AS PROCESSED_ADMIN_ID, adminAccount.NAME AS PROCESSED_ADMIN_NAME, adminAccount.ROLE AS PROCESSED_ADMIN_ROLE,
processLog.CREATED_AT AS PROCESSED_AT, processLog.ACTION_TYPE, processLog.PROCESS_MEMO,
CASE WHEN processLog.CODE IS NULL OR processLog.ACTION_TYPE IS NULL OR processLog.ACTION_TYPE = 'REJECT' THEN NULL
WHEN changeLog.EVENT_TYPE = 'CANCEL' THEN 'CANCELED'
ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS ACTION_STATUS,
processLog.SUSPENSION_PERIOD, processLog.SUSPENDED_UNTIL
FROM REPORT r
LEFT JOIN MEMBER_ACCOUNT reporter ON reporter.CODE = r.MEM_CODE
LEFT JOIN FEED f ON r.TARGET_TYPE = 'feed' AND f.CODE = r.TARGET_CODE
LEFT JOIN COMMENTS c ON r.TARGET_TYPE = 'comment' AND c.CODE = r.TARGET_CODE
LEFT JOIN MARKET_PRODUCT p ON r.TARGET_TYPE = 'market' AND p.CODE = r.TARGET_CODE
LEFT JOIN MEMBER_ACCOUNT targetMember ON targetMember.CODE = COALESCE(f.MEM_CODE, c.MEM_CODE, p.MEM_CODE)
LEFT JOIN REPORT_LOG processLog ON processLog.CODE = ( SELECT history.CODE FROM REPORT_LOG history WHERE history.REPORT_CODE = r.CODE AND history.EVENT_TYPE = 'PROCESS' ORDER BY history.CREATED_AT DESC, history.CODE DESC LIMIT 1 )
LEFT JOIN ADMIN_ACCOUNT adminAccount ON adminAccount.CODE = processLog.ADM_CODE
LEFT JOIN REPORT_LOG changeLog ON changeLog.CODE = ( SELECT changes.CODE FROM REPORT_LOG changes WHERE changes.REPORT_CODE = r.CODE AND changes.RELATED_LOG_CODE = processLog.CODE AND changes.EVENT_TYPE IN ('CANCEL', 'RESTORE') ORDER BY changes.CREATED_AT DESC, changes.CODE DESC LIMIT 1 )
WHERE r.CODE = #{reportCode}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_report_count,
COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN r.STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'IN_REVIEW') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS pending_report_count,
COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN r.STATUS = 'RESOLVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS resolved_report_count
FROM REPORT r
